# Lessons Ledger

<!-- Status: awaiting-content -->
<!-- Generated by /lessons assemble — do not edit Record tables directly -->
<!-- Last assembled: 2026-04-20 by Ben Xavier (bootstrap) -->

This ledger is a team-shared staging area for lessons captured from task work. The lifecycle is:

```
Task (tagged) → Ledger Staged → Final home via /lessons promote
                                 ├─ skill <name>    (audited by /best-practices)
                                 ├─ claude-md       (loaded every session)
                                 ├─ agent <name>    (agent prompt)
                                 ├─ rule <name>     (.claude/rules/)
                                 ├─ glossary        (glossary.md)
                                 ├─ standard <id>   (standards applicability)
                                 └─ readme <path>   (folder README)
```

**Do not edit this file directly.** Lesson content comes from `<!-- LESSONS LEARNED -->` tags in task docs; record tables come from `## Lesson Records` sections in task docs. Run `/lessons assemble` to regenerate.

**Loading**: Only the `## Staged` section is loaded at session start via `CLAUDE.md`. The `## Promoted` and `## Archived / Superseded` sections are audit trail only.

---

## Staged

Active lessons under reinforcement. When a situation matches one of these, Claude surfaces a prompt before acting; the user picks `apply`, `exception`, `challenged`, or `false-positive`, and `/lessons record` logs the event in the active task.

_No staged lessons yet. Run `/lessons assemble` to populate from tagged content in task docs._

---

## Promoted

Audit trail of lessons that have reached their permanent home. **Not loaded at session start.** This section exists for traceability — the lesson content now lives in the destination (skill, CLAUDE.md, agent, rule, glossary, standard, or README).

_No promoted lessons yet._

---

## Archived / Superseded

Lessons that were discarded after records showed they were wrong, or superseded by a newer task's insight. Historical only — preserved so we can see what didn't work and why.

_No archived lessons yet._
